summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: The package declares itself a small "conversation context manager" and ships a plain, readable index.js consistent with that purpose. However, package.json defines a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) whose actual behavior is to check for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, download Bun v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extract it to a temporary directory, chmod +x, and invoke it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line minified bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, obfuscated with rotated string-array indirection (a `WV8StW` shift-rotator and a large numeric/string dictionary `n7gIxM`) and mangled identifiers; it is not referenced by index.js and is reachable only via this preinstall drop-and-exec path. The loader setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style mangled (`_0xNNNNNN` hex identifiers and per-function alias tables wrapping every fs/https/exec call) to hide the platform detection, URL construction, download, unzip, chmod, and execFileSync chain. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute a heavily obfuscated sibling payload unrelated to the package's advertised functionality is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, and the payload executes automatically on `npm install`, bypassing Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
